# CodeDeploy deployment execution and agents

**Status: proposed.** This service or extension is not implemented in the registered API profiles.
The scope below is a design candidate, without an assigned version or delivery date.

## First useful slice

Extend application, deployment configuration and group records to real deployment execution.

## Proposed scope

- [ ] Deployment execution and agents
- [ ] Application revisions
- [ ] Lifecycle hooks and deployment targets
- [ ] Blue/green traffic management

## Integration decisions

Current CodeDeploy support stores configuration records only. It never reports fake successful deployment executions.
